analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free in the fuzzer harness: in case 50, fuzz_canvas builds a temporary SkTDArray<uint8_t> text and passes text.begin() to canvas->drawTextRSXform(). The draw path stores/uses glyph run data derived from that pointer during device iteration, but the backing text storage is later freed in fuzz_canvas (free at line ~1569), leading to stale glyph/glyph-position span data being read in SkGlyphRun::eachGlyphToGlyphRun(). Root cause is unsafe lifetime management of text memory in fuzz_canvas, not SkGlyphRun itself.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires selecting fuzz_canvas draw op case 50 (drawTextRSXform) with non-empty generated text so drawTextRSXform executes. The harness creates text from fuzzer bytes, calls drawTextRSXform with that transient buffer, and then the same fuzz_canvas invocation frees memory that was allocated/reallocated for text/blob-related storage. A later glyph iteration in the RSXform draw path dereferences spans pointing to freed memory, producing the ASan heap-use-after-free.
